fluff.overview: Despite the low regard most Clans hold for conventional infantry, these formations benefit from incidental access to Clan technology that makes even a disaffected garrison Point a match for its Inner Sphere equivalent. Foot Points are the most basic infantry formation, deployed on foot without transport. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, they are best suited to garrison duty, facility security, and defensive positions where their lack of mobility is less of a liability. Configured as a Watch detachment, this Point operates in an intelligence-gathering and surveillance capacity, armed for self-defense rather than front-line combat.
